title: HR Policy 6007 - Recruitment and Hiring
chunks: ST. MARY’S HOME HUMAN RESOURCES Employment Regulation Cross Reference: Policy # 6007 Page 1 of 2 (Licensing regs etc.) Approved: Subject: RECRUITMENT AND HIRING Tone 4 onto Issued: January 2011 Revised: May 2025, Oct. 2025, March 2026 PURPOSE: To ensure that the Home complies with all Virginia Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services license requirements, the Equal Employment Office and the Department of Labor relating to use of a consistent recruitment and employment process. DEFINITIONS: ATS — Applicant Tracking System HR — Human Resources PROCEDURE: 1. RECRUITING OUTREACH: A. Open positions are posted intemally for three days. Openings that do not gain internal interest or have specific requirements may be posted extemally through a variety of sources including online career boards. B. Participation in local job fairs, career guidance departments and internal open houses may be used to promote opportunities at St. Mary’s Home. C. Referral bonuses are offered and outlined in Policy # 6024 under PERKS. HIRING PROCESS A. Interviews for open positions are scheduled by the HR Department, for both intemal and external applicants. B. Intemal applicants who meet the requirements and qualifications will be directed to submit their application through the Kronos system. They should identify that they are a “current employee” on their application. C. All active applicants will be reviewed daily by HR and followed up on accordingly. This will include pre-screening, interview confirmations, offers/rejections and onboarding. Observations will be scheduled by the hiring manager during the interview process. D. All licensed applicants must produce a copy of their current license or an Authorization to Test/Authorization to Practice letter. The following paperwork will also be completed: e New Hire Information form e Disclosure Statement e Virginia Department of Social Services Background Check form e Federal Tax form W4 e« Commonwealth of Virginia State Tax form e 19 form « Direct Deposit form « Reference Check form e Unum Life Beneficiary form e Orientation Overview Sign Off form « Contingent Offer of Employment « Nowcare Pre-Employment Drug Test, TB Screening, Flu Shot E. Following a contingent offer of employment, Federal and State background checks will be completed. F. Results of the background checks will determine Eligibility for Hire. e “Eligible for Hire” will be considered for official offer of employment « “Not Eligible for Hire” will have offers rescinded e “Unable to Determine” will be considered for hire without a Misdemeanor within 5 years; Felony within 10 years. e Actions of a violent nature in the background of the applicant will eliminate them from the selection process 2|Page
